senses.gloss:
धेनु धे + नु, f.
 1. A milch cow, one that has lately calved, Man. 11, 137.
 2. The earth, MBh. 13, 3165.
 3. Gift, MBh. 3, 12727; in this signification the word is used especially as [] latter part of comp. words, e. g. तिल, MBh. 13, 3286; घृत-, 3523, etc., which imply that sesame, ghee, etc., are given instead of a milch cow, a milch cow being the usual present given to a Brāhmaṇa.
 --Comp.

धेनुक धेनु + क,
 I. m. The name of a demon, MBh. 5, 4410.
 II. f. का.
 1. A milch cow, 3, 13035.
 2. A present (cf. धेनु
 3), 3, 8065.
